Command.Statement: With Set [*NATIVE_CJ_SET] as 'NonEmptyCrossJoin([*BASE_MEMBERS_Store],[*BASE_MEMBERS_Product])' Set [*BASE_MEMBERS_Store] as '{[Store].[All Stores].[USA]}' Set [*GENERATED_MEMBERS_Store] as 'Generate([*NATIVE_CJ_SET], {[Store].CurrentMember})' Set [*BASE_MEMBERS_Product] as '{[Product].[All Products].[Food],[Product].[All Products].[Drink]}' Set [*GENERATED_MEMBERS_Product] as 'Generate([*NATIVE_CJ_SET], {[Product].CurrentMember})' Member [Store].[*FILTER_MEMBER] as 'Aggregate ([*GENERATED_MEMBERS_Store])' Member [Product].[*FILTER_MEMBER] as 'Aggregate ([*GENERATED_MEMBERS_Product])' Select {[Measures].[Store Sales]} on columns from [ZFMSALES] Where ([Store].[*FILTER_MEMBER], [Product].[*FILTER_MEMBER])
